name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Partner Success & Customer Operations Leader
summary: Partner and account operations leader with 15+ years managing high-value B2B relationships across SaaS and agency environments, including onboarding and retaining a network of 15-20 reseller/channel partners at roughly 94% retention. Skilled at owning a partner or client portfolio end to end: prioritizing competing requests, resolving delivery blockers, and escalating real risk before it costs a relationship, backed by hands-on CRM and workflow-automation architecture (Salesforce, HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Accelo PSA).

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Own the primary strategic relationship for a portfolio of B2B service clients, running discovery and onboarding to surface goals, priorities, and operational risk.
Run day-to-day delivery across concurrent client engagements, prioritizing competing requests and resolving delivery blockers directly with business owners and stakeholders.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable in GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, keeping project records auditable across concurrent engagements.
Architect and deploy CRM and workflow-automation systems (GoHighLevel, Zapier, Make, n8n) that route, prioritize, and escalate tasks through a client's full lifecycle.
Report performance on a regular cadence with actionable insights and recommendations, backed by tracking across delivery, retention, and operations.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder accounts across marketing and technology channels, translating performance data into strategic recommendations and coordinating execution across internal departments.
Built rigorous campaign performance reporting frameworks tracking ROI and conversion KPIs, delivering optimization recommendations and QBRs.
Held delivery quality consistent across implementations, resolving client feedback promptly to protect satisfaction and retention.
Advised client businesses on budget planning and allocation across paid campaigns.

experience.title: Partner Success Manager - Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Served as primary point of contact for a network of 15-20 reseller/channel partners (deal sizes ~$10K-$45K), retaining all but one (~94% retention) through proactive, transparent communication on project status and risk.

Sold and onboarded partners onto Birdeye's proprietary data-aggregator/listings-syndication platform, the backbone of the channel offer, ensuring every partner's end customer had a properly configured setup.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, evaluating partner fitness and escalating significant risk to leadership to protect renewal and utilization.
Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network spanning health, home services, and retail verticals, driving rapid adoption of automation and reputation-management tools.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance data to identify adoption gaps and recommend interventions that reduced churn.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to surface structured, high-priority partner feedback informing the roadmap.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets against a continuous intake queue.
Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (a team of 20, later a team of 8), overseeing scope and delivery timelines for a high-value client portfolio.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture across the team.
Managed a high-value account portfolio across diverse verticals, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

experience.title: Implementation Strategy - Account Executive
bullets: Sold and scoped Accelo's own CRM/PSA (professional services automation) platform to agencies and professional-services firms, with deep fluency in pipeline, workflow, and resource-scheduling configuration.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, and handed them to the implementation team to execute against.
Guided client onboarding, workflow design, and API integrations, building relationships with C-suite executives as a trusted advisor on operational system design.
Ranked top three in sales on a team that scaled from 8 to 15 reps, holding that rank across all but the final few months of a 27-month tenure while quota roughly doubled.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO (2009)
certifications: Google Digital Marketing & E-Commerce Professional Certificate - Google / Coursera (2024)
